road_speed_calibration.scope: spot speed-bin midpoints; not OD travel times or ride-hailing behavior

manifest.matching_backend: sequential multinomial driver choice with outside option

metric_definitions.service_rate: Completed by horizon / arrived potential requests
metric_definitions.mean_wait_min: Request-to-pickup minutes, riders actually collected only
metric_definitions.utilization_rate: Elapsed pickup + occupied minutes / fleet minutes; excludes repositioning
metric_definitions.platform_net_revenue_cad: Rider payments minus gross driver earnings; before operating costs
metric_definitions.total_pickup_time_min: Planned pickup duration for accepted assignments
metric_definitions.total_trip_time_min: Planned occupied duration for accepted assignments
metric_definitions.unserved_trips: Cancelled + price declined + still waiting at horizon

run.matching_backend: sequential multinomial driver choice with outside option
run.policy_objective: serve demand with minimum pickup time
run.policy_strategy: fixed fares and deterministic nearest-driver offers
